version: V196 real-intervention / behavior learning / teacher-student adoption pilot
authority: Latest direct user: 可以，那你执行吧; implement V195 as a bounded four-group pilot.

fixed_inputs.source: Genuine V190 base checkpoints at 147456 steps, same sources as V191, no old evaluation rerun
fixed_inputs.case_rule: First two captured source episodes ending by step96 with a stationary action in last8; select earliest such action in last8. No effect-based case changes. Missing cases retained.
fixed_inputs.legal_alternatives: original action and normal directional rotations +2/-2, distinct legal only; full suffix until actual terminal

learning.shared_data: All groups/ordinary reference receive all actually executed source and trial data; counterfactual prefixes explicitly reused, not counted as fresh steps. RL uses only reward/TD labels, no preference loss or factual heads. F0 no reward packet or Q.
learning.retain: Every optimizer update includes original ordinary learner loss on real old replay plus new executed data.
learning.teacher_selection: Strictly higher mean official task score than ordinary reference on fresh train-map development episodes. Cycle1 both proposals executed. Cycle2 Dream-selected order, stop after first qualifying teacher.
learning.sleep: Only task-validated teacher; student starts from ordinary reference; real student wake trajectories with same-observation teacher shadow; legal full-action KL T=0.25 plus real old/new ordinary losses.
learning.student_adoption: Strictly greater mean score than ordinary reference AND captured count no greater on a separate16episode train-map gate. Otherwise retain ordinary reference. Final64report never consulted.
learning.uncertainty: 16episode selection is noisy and not a scientific significance test; four existing trained seeds, not fresh-from-scratch N.
learning.matched_sleep_reference: Whenever a teacher qualifies, ordinary reference receives the SAME student-wake factual data and16 additional ordinary updates; student receives16 ordinary+behavior-KL updates. Data and update count match for the Sleep comparison.
learning.data_store: New real source/trial/student trajectories stored separately; frozen historical Replay remains read-only. Offline batches include old normal learner loss + new actual labels, fixed target network per fit. No fabricated old replay UIDs; exact source prefixes reused as history, not native steps.

dream.history: Executed parent->candidate networks with actual task-probe outcomes and costs; unknown children unavailable. Compare which recorded child beats reference under one-proposal historical budget; incumbent retained on ties. Cycle2 uses selected order. Not original LLM code-rewrite replication.

cost_scope: Component/closed-loop pilot. All source/trial/probe/student/gate/report steps and every optimizer update (including rejected candidates and ordinary reference) counted. Shared source/trial data and reference are charged explicitly as shared work, not free learner improvement. Optimizer/validation overhead is NOT claimed matched to ordinary-only production cost; cannot infer net efficiency or isolated Dream/Sleep benefit.
evaluation_scope: Training-map source/probes/gates only; final-report fresh seen/heldout-map episodes after adoption decisions. Teacher, student and ordinary reference compared on same final64 bank when applicable.
